notes.title: Update 2024/3/2
notes.content:
Thank you to all the reviewers for your constructive suggestions. Based on your feedback, some adjustments have been made to the gameplay!

Update list:
1. The earnings from Russian Roulette have been adjusted from 100 to 500.
2. The earnings from wine tasting have been adjusted from 10 to 200.
3. The four attributes of the Orc have been reduced to 30.
4. The minimum and maximum earnings from illegal work have been increased to 10 and 50, respectively.
5. The instructor has added a new dialogue to guide beginners at the start.
